title: The Hajj Pilgrimage — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: The Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca is required once in a lifetime for Muslims who are physically and financially able. It takes place in the Islamic month of Dhu al-Hijjah and draws millions of pilgrims together. This overview edition presents The Hajj Pilgrimage within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
